source_name: EU u Srbiji / euzatebe.rs — 'EU javni pozivi' (EU calls listing, sr)
why_relevant: EU Delegation-run Serbian-language listing of EU calls and tenders; a model for how EU-channel notices are localised in sr, and occasionally carries regional/multi-country calls that include Kosovo. Useful for sr-language terminology harvesting ('javni pozivi', 'EU tenderi').

source_name: EULEX Kosovo — procurement notices
why_relevant: EU CSDP mission in Kosovo running its own EU-rules procurement; marginal for payments/banking scope but part of the EU-level contracting surface reaching Kosovo and occasionally covering IT/financial administration services.

source_name: EUR-Lex — Participation of Kosovo in EU programmes (legal basis summaries)
why_relevant: Establishes which EU programmes Kosovo may participate in and under what agreements — determines whether a given EU call is even open to Kosovo entities, which is the eligibility filter for the whole cell.

source_name: NLB Banka Kosovo - Ftesë për ofertim (tender invitations)
why_relevant: Systemic Kosovo bank publishing its own RFQ/RFP invitations, organised by year (2024-2026), including highly on-topic items: cash/coin counting and verification machines, UPS for the server room, LAN implementation, SWIFT CSCF assessment, AI document verification, archive document management software, safes. Direct visibility of private-bank IT/cash/self-service procurement that never reaches the public e-procurement portal.

source_name: BKT Kosova - Tenderë archive (Kërkesë për Ofertë)
why_relevant: Dedicated WordPress custom-post-type tender archive of Banka Kombëtare Tregtare Kosova. Observed notices cover PC/monitor/laptop/phone supply, call-centre maintenance and configuration, pay-per-print services, safe (dropbox) purchase, marketing agency, fuel — i.e. a running feed of a top-5 Kosovo bank's IT and facilities buying. English mirror exists at /en/bkt_tenders/.

source_name: TEB Sh.A. (Kosovo) - Tenders page with RFQ/IFB/RFP PDFs
why_relevant: TEB (BNP Paribas / TEB Holding JV) publishes structured procurement notices explicitly typed RFQ / IFB / RFP with downloadable PDF tender documents, deadline-extension notices, and an archive. Observed subjects include generator supply, TVRA (threat & vulnerability risk assessment) for data centres, IT equipment and software, construction/renovation, security and facility management — the richest document-level detail of any Kosovo bank found in this cell.

source_name: Banka Ekonomike - Ankande dhe Shpallje (auctions and announcements)
why_relevant: Mixed feed of procurement invitations and collateral auctions from a fully domestic Kosovo bank. Search evidence points to a call for supply of POS and ATM receipt rolls, and the live page shows illuminated-signage supply/installation/servicing and generator rental — i.e. exactly the consumables/self-service/facilities layer that never appears on public portals. Offers are submitted in sealed envelopes at the Prishtina head office, so notices are the only public trace.

source_name: BPB (Banka për Biznes) - Ftesat për Ofertë
why_relevant: Domestic bank's call-for-offers page with downloadable tender documents. Live listings observed include bank premises renovation and — highly relevant to cash/self-service intelligence — security services covering cash-in-transit, physical guarding, monitoring centre and ATM management (bankomatët). ATM fleet management outsourcing is a strategic signal rarely visible elsewhere.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo - Shpallje për tenderë (tender announcements hub)
why_relevant: Official procurement hub of the largest foreign-owned bank in Kosovo. Carries the bank's General Terms and Conditions for procurement (PDF) and the RBI Group Code of Conduct for Suppliers, and names the procurement contact prokurimi@raiffeisen-kosovo.com. The rules documents are as valuable as the notices: they define how a vendor can qualify and what the bank's award process looks like.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Shqipëri - Procese prokurimi (sibling-entity procurement page)
why_relevant: Same RBI group, same Albanian-language market conventions and often the same regional vendors and platform decisions. Publishes tendering-process announcements with documentation (contact procurement.department@raiffeisen.al). Useful as a template for what Raiffeisen Kosovo publishes internally and as an early indicator of group-standard technology rollouts reaching Kosovo.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Serbia - Tenders page (group tender-publication pattern)
why_relevant: Demonstrates that ProCredit group banks publish tenders on a per-bank /tenders path. Serbian-language notices from a neighbouring ProCredit entity indicate group-wide procurement rules and shared vendors; also the strongest lead for inferring where a ProCredit Kosovo tender page would live if one is activated.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova - Business ethics / corporate pages (procurement-rules surface)
why_relevant: ProCredit Kosovo showed no dedicated tender page in any sq/en query, but the group states its tender procedure follows equal-competition and 'value for money' principles. The business-ethics/governance pages are the only public surface where ProCredit Kosovo's procurement rules and supplier expectations would be documented, and any future tender link would most plausibly appear in this section or under lajme/shpallje.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International - Code of Conduct for Suppliers / group procurement governance
why_relevant: RBI Group Procurement (headed at group level) sets binding rules that Raiffeisen Kosovo applies, including anti-collusion clauses that forbid suppliers disclosing anything about planned, running or pending RBI Group procurements. That clause itself is intelligence: it explains why Raiffeisen Kosovo notices are thin publicly and why vendor-side sources will be silent. The RBI platform login page is the entry point to group vendor-facing platforms.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine - Procurement principles page (group procurement doctrine, readable)
why_relevant: The most fully public statement of Raiffeisen-group procurement principles, categories and vendor-qualification steps found in this cell. Useful as a proxy for how Raiffeisen Kosovo structures categories and evaluates bids, which helps interpret the sparse Kosovo notices.

source_name: NLB Group corporate site (parent-level procurement / group tech rollouts)
why_relevant: NLB d.d. Ljubljana is the parent of NLB Banka Kosovo and increasingly centralises platform decisions across its six SEE subsidiary banks. No group supplier portal was found, but group press releases announce platform launches (e.g. the March 2026 Trgovski portal release) that later drive local Kosovo procurement. It is a pointer to which vendors and systems will surface in Prishtina.

source_name: Ziraat Bank Kosova - Lajmërime (announcements)
why_relevant: Ziraat Bank Kosova SHA (Turkish state parent, locally incorporated as of May 2025) has no visible tender or supplier section; the general announcements feed is the only plausible public channel where a procurement notice would appear. Its legal transformation into a Kosovo joint-stock company is itself a driver of new local procurement (systems, licensing, reporting).

source_name: CBK / Wikipedia consolidated list of licensed banks in Kosovo (actor map anchor)
why_relevant: Recurring anchor across every query in this cell; enumerates the full licensed set (ProCredit, Raiffeisen, NLB, TEB, BKT, BpB, Banka Ekonomike, Ziraat, Türkiye İş Bankası, PriBank) so no private buyer is missed when building the per-bank tender-page crawl list. The authoritative version is the CBK register, which this mirrors.

source_name: Raiffeisen Kosovo - Call for Sponsorship applications (adjacent public solicitation channel)
why_relevant: Not a procurement source, but it proves the bank runs open public calls with published terms and deadlines on its own site, and it is the sibling page pattern of the tender-announcement hub. Useful for confirming whether the bank's public-call template renders notices dynamically (which would explain the empty tender page observed).

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për autorizimin, dhënien e miratimeve dhe qeverisjen e IP-ve dhe IPE-ve / registration of AISPs (B15)
why_relevant: Defines the licensing gate that creates new payment-institution buyers and imposes obligations (outsourcing approval, security, agent registration) that translate directly into technology procurement. Regulation vintages signal upcoming compliance-driven spend waves.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për qasjen e ofruesve të shërbimeve të pagesave jo-banka në sistemet e pagesave
why_relevant: Non-bank PSP access to the Interbank Payment System is the trigger for non-bank players to buy connectivity, settlement and instant-payment integration technology; the regulation dates the opening of that market segment.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për agjentët e ofruesve të shërbimit të pagesave dhe parasë elektronike
why_relevant: Agent networks are the physical distribution channel of Kosovo remittance and e-money firms; the agent regime governs registration of agent points and therefore the scale of agent-facing terminal, till and KYC tooling procurement.

source_name: BQK — Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë / Use of Bank Cards in Kosovo (annual report series)
why_relevant: Annual card/ATM/POS fleet statistics by institution and region — the demand-side sizing that indicates terminal-fleet renewal cycles and which acquirers/processors are growing; the closest public proxy for POS and ATM estate size in Kosovo.

source_name: njoftimetenderi.com — commercial Kosovo tender aggregator
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator that mirrors and indexes Kosovo contract notices in a far more scrapable form than the state portal; useful as a redundancy layer and for full-text search of payment-related notice titles.
